headline.bm: Trump kata boleh tamatkan perang Iran bila-bila masa manakala Iran berikrar memecahkan sekatan AS, Brent sekitar $96; hari penamaan calon Sarawak lihat GPS menang tanpa bertanding di 8 kerusi setakat ini; PM minta Loke sambung tugas Menteri Pengangkutan.
headline.en: Trump says he can end the Iran war whenever he wants while Iran vows to break the US blockade, Brent near $96; Sarawak nomination day sees GPS unopposed in 8 seats so far; PM asks Loke to resume Transport duties.

summary.bm: Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim meminta Anthony Loke menyambung semula tugas sebagai Menteri Pengangkutan secepat mungkin, lapor Sinar Harian pada 28 Nov.
summary.en: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has asked Anthony Loke to return to his duties as Transport Minister as soon as possible, Sinar Harian reported on 28 Nov.

title.bm: PM minta Anthony Loke sambung tugas Menteri Pengangkutan secepat mungkin
title.en: PM asks Anthony Loke to resume Transport Minister duties as soon as possible

why.bm: Portfolio pengangkutan merangkumi pelancaran ECRL pada 12 Dis serta isu lebuh raya dan penerbangan.
why.en: Transport portfolio covers the ECRL launch due 12 Dec and highway and aviation issues.

summary.bm: Enam orang, termasuk tiga pegawai TUDM, didakwa di Shah Alam berhubung kira-kira 96.2kg disyaki metamfetamina di pangkalan udara TUDM Subang. Polis berkata jumlah suspek ditahan kini 18 orang, manakala Perdana Menteri menyifatkan dakwaan penggunaan pesawat tentera udara itu sebagai pengkhianatan serius terhadap keselamatan negara.
summary.en: Six people, including three RMAF officers, were charged at Shah Alam over about 96.2kg of suspected methamphetamine at RMAF Subang air base. Police say total suspects held has reached 18, and the PM called the alleged use of an air force aircraft a serious betrayal of national security.

title.bm: Anwar: penyeludupan dadah membabitkan pesawat TUDM satu 'pengkhianatan negara' ketika tahanan capai 18 orang
title.en: Anwar calls RMAF-linked drug smuggling a 'betrayal of the nation' as arrests hit 18

why.bm: Menguji integriti aset utama angkatan tentera dan kepercayaan awam terhadap institusi keselamatan negara.
why.en: Tests the integrity of a key armed-forces asset and public trust in national security institutions.

summary.bm: SPR berkata GPS menang tanpa bertanding di lapan daripada 82 kerusi setakat ini, termasuk Premier di Gedong (N26) dan Lidam Assan di Katibas. Laporan awal mengenai 44 kerusi tanpa pertandingan dibuat sebelum penamaan calon ditutup dan semakan Jabatan Peguam Negara belum selesai; pengundian kerusi yang ditandingi pada 12 Dis.
summary.en: The Election Commission says GPS has won eight of the 82 seats unopposed so far, including the Premier in Gedong (N26) and Lidam Assan in Katibas. Earlier reports of 44 uncontested seats were before nominations closed and the Attorney General's Chambers review was pending; polling for contested seats is on 12 Dec.

title.bm: Hari penamaan calon PRN Sarawak: GPS diisytihar menang tanpa bertanding di 8 kerusi setakat ini, termasuk Premier Abang Johari di Gedong; angka 44 kerusi sebelum ini belum disahkan
title.en: Sarawak nomination day: GPS declared unopposed in 8 seats so far, Premier Abang Johari in Gedong; earlier 44-seat figure not confirmed

why.bm: Kerajaan terbentuk sebelum hari mengundi merupakan sesuatu yang luar biasa dan mempengaruhi suasana politik menjelang PRU16.
why.en: A government formed before polling day would be a first in recent Sarawak politics and shapes the GE16 mood.

summary.bm: MCMC berkata YouTube gagal membendung kandungan berbahaya dan saman telah diserahkan; ia diterima peguam Google di Malaysia.
summary.en: MCMC says YouTube failed to curb harmful content and has served the suit; it was handed to Google's lawyers in Malaysia.

title.bm: MCMC serah saman kepada Google dalam tuntutan RM600 juta berhubung kandungan berbahaya YouTube
title.en: MCMC serves Google in RM600m lawsuit over YouTube harmful content

why.bm: Ujian sejauh mana Malaysia boleh menuntut akauntabiliti platform besar terhadap bahaya dalam talian.
why.en: A test of how far Malaysia can hold big platforms to account for online harm.

summary.bm: Sinar Harian melaporkan menteri berkata kerajaan tidak berhasrat mengambil alih konsesi lebuh raya, manakala Johor mempersoalkan penangguhan kali kedua pelancaran pelan induk SEZ Johor-Singapura.
summary.en: Sinar Harian reports the minister said the government does not intend to take over highway concessions, while Johor questions the second postponement of the Johor-Singapore SEZ master plan launch.

title.bm: Kerajaan tiada hasrat ambil alih konsesi lebuh raya; pelancaran pelan induk JS-SEZ ditangguh kali kedua
title.en: Govt has no plan to take over highway concessions; JS-SEZ master plan launch delayed a second time

why.bm: Menjejaskan jangkaan tol dan zon pelaburan rentas sempadan utama.
why.en: Affects toll expectations and a flagship cross-border investment zone.

summary.bm: Miti berkata Malaysia akan terus berunding dengan Washington sehingga suku pertama 2027 supaya jumlah tarif AS kekal dalam had 19% di bawah Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik; AS membayangkan julat 18–25% di bawah Seksyen 301. Malaysia antara 14 ekonomi yang berdepan cadangan tarif Seksyen 301 sebanyak 15–35%. MITI berkata Malaysia akan terus berunding sehingga S1 2027 supaya tarif kekal dalam kadar 19% yang dipersetujui.
summary.en: Miti says Malaysia will keep negotiating with Washington into Q1 2027 so total US tariffs stay within the 19% ceiling agreed under the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade; the US has signalled an 18–25% range under Section 301. Malaysia is one of 14 economies facing proposed Section 301 tariffs of 15–35%. MITI says Malaysia will keep negotiating until Q1 2027 to keep tariffs within the agreed 19%.

title.bm: AS cadang tarif Seksyen 301 sehingga 18% ke atas barangan Malaysia, 25% jika rundingan gagal
title.en: US proposes Section 301 tariffs of up to 18% on Malaysian goods, 25% if talks falter

why.bm: Menjejaskan pengeksport Malaysia, terutama elektronik dan komponen automotif; Malaysia menegaskan rejim perdagangannya berasaskan peraturan dan pasaran.
why.en: Hits Malaysian exporters, especially electronics and auto parts; Malaysia says it runs a rule-based, market-based trade regime.

summary.bm: Dalam 'Dialog Negara: Di Sebalik Keputusan' di RTM, Anwar berkata PRU16 boleh diadakan sebelum atau selepas Hari Merdeka tahun depan, manakala komposisi kerajaan selepas itu bergantung kepada keputusan dan sokongan parti. Topik lain termasuk pembangunan semula bandar, perkhidmatan kesihatan awam, pendidikan kesihatan mental, cadangan dana kekayaan AI dan antirasuah.
summary.en: On RTM's 'Dialog Negara: Di Sebalik Keputusan', Anwar said the 16th general election could fall before or after Merdeka Day next year, with the post-election government depending on results and party support. Topics also included urban redevelopment, public health services, mental health education, a proposed AI wealth fund and anti-corruption.

title.bm: Anwar: PRU16 mesti diadakan sebelum Februari 2028, minta rakyat bersabar
title.en: Anwar: GE16 must be held before February 2028, asks public to be patient

why.bm: Menetapkan had masa pilihan raya umum akan datang dan mempengaruhi kiraan politik menjelang Bajet 2027 dan PRN.
why.en: Sets the outer limit for the next election and keeps political calculations alive for Budget 2027 and state polls.

summary.bm: Malay Mail dan Bernama melaporkan PM berkata Malaysia kekal komited kepada diplomasi dalam isu Laut China Selatan dan pendatang Myanmar. Dasar Keselamatan Negara baharu turut meletakkan keselamatan siber sebagai keutamaan tersendiri.
summary.en: Malay Mail and Bernama report the PM said Malaysia stays committed to diplomacy on South China Sea issues and on Myanmar migrants. The new National Security Policy also lists cybersecurity as a separate priority.

title.bm: Anwar di pelancaran dasar keselamatan negara: diplomasi diutamakan bagi pelarian Myanmar dan Laut China Selatan; keselamatan siber diberi keutamaan tersendiri
title.en: Anwar at national security policy launch: diplomacy first on Myanmar refugees and South China Sea; cybersecurity gets its own priority

why.bm: Menentukan hala tuju kerajaan terhadap ancaman sempadan, maritim dan siber yang menjejaskan rakyat serta pengendali IT.
why.en: Sets the government's direction on border, maritime and cyber threats that affect everyday Malaysians and IT operators.

summary.bm: Rang Undang-Undang Perbekalan 2027 diluluskan pada bacaan kali ketiga 26 Nov tanpa sebarang ahli pembangkang meminta undi belah bahagi. Ia merangkumi RM376.8 bilion perbelanjaan mengurus dan RM83 bilion pembangunan, selepas Perjanjian Keyakinan dan Perbekalan 29 Okt.
summary.en: The Supply Bill 2027 passed third reading on 26 Nov with no Opposition MP calling a bloc vote. It includes RM376.8bn operating and RM83bn development spending, after the 29 Oct Confidence and Supply Agreement.

title.bm: Dewan Rakyat lulus Belanjawan 2027 bernilai RM459.8 bilion melalui undi suara
title.en: Dewan Rakyat passes RM459.8bn Budget 2027 by voice vote

why.bm: Mengesahkan peruntukan kerajaan dan kestabilan politik bagi 2027.
why.en: Confirms government funding and political stability for 2027.

summary.bm: Reuters: Nikkei naik 0.7% tetapi jatuh 8.4% bagi bulan ini; MSCI Asia-Pasifik tanpa Jepun susut 8.2% pada November. Brent hampir $96 (turun kira-kira 18% sebulan) dan dolar menuju kenaikan bulanan ketiga, dengan niaga hadapan meletakkan 99% kebarangkalian kenaikan 25 mata asas Fed pada Disember.
summary.en: Reuters: Nikkei rose 0.7% but is down 8.4% for the month; MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan is down 8.2% in November. Brent was near $96 (about 18% lower on the month) and the dollar was set for a third monthly gain, with futures pricing a 99% chance of a 25bp Fed hike in December.

title.bm: Saham Asia stabil selepas November yang perit; Brent sekitar $96, niaga hadapan jangka kenaikan kadar Fed Disember
title.en: Asian shares steady after a bruising November; Brent about $96, futures price a December Fed hike

why.bm: Kadar AS yang tinggi dan dolar kukuh menekan ringgit serta pasaran Asia, manakala minyak mengekalkan kos bahan api dan subsidi dalam tumpuan.
why.en: Higher US rates and a strong dollar pressure the ringgit and Asian markets, and oil keeps fuel and subsidy costs in focus.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan laporan pekerjaan AS Jumaat dijangka menunjukkan gaji bukan ladang November naik 90,000 (Oktober: 165,000), dan pasaran menjangka kenaikan kadar Fed 25 atau 50 mata asas pada 8-9 Disember. OPEC+ bersidang di Vienna Ahad dengan sasaran pengeluaran dijangka tidak berubah sekurang-kurangnya hingga suku pertama 2027, manakala Sepanyol mengundi dalam pilihan raya mengejut dan RBI dijangka menaikkan kadar kepada 5.75% pada 4 Disember.
summary.en: Reuters says Friday's US jobs report is expected to show November payrolls up 90,000 (October: 165,000), and markets expect a Fed hike of 25 or 50bp on 8-9 December. OPEC+ meets in Vienna on Sunday with output targets expected unchanged for at least Q1 2027, while Spain votes in a snap election and the RBI is expected to raise rates to 5.75% on 4 December.

title.bm: Pasaran bersiap untuk Disember yang sibuk: gaji bukan ladang AS, kenaikan kadar Fed, OPEC+ dan pilihan raya mengejut Sepanyol
title.en: Markets brace for a busy December: US payrolls, a Fed hike, OPEC+ and a Spanish snap election

why.bm: Kadar global lebih tinggi dan turun naik minyak memberi kesan kepada ringgit, kos bahan api dan kos pinjaman di Malaysia.
why.en: Higher global rates and oil swings feed into the ringgit, fuel costs and Malaysian borrowing costs.

summary.bm: AS mengumumkan tarif berkaitan 'pengeluaran berlebihan' membabitkan 14 entiti ekonomi termasuk Korea Selatan; had 15% dalam perjanjian dagang Seoul dikekalkan, tetapi Washington membuka ruang menaikkannya ke 25% kelak. Indeks PCE Oktober meningkat, dengan inflasi teras tertinggi sejak 2023, menguatkan jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed pada Disember.
summary.en: The US announced tariffs aimed at 'overproduction' covering 14 economic entities including South Korea; Seoul's 15% cap under its trade deal was kept, but Washington left room to raise it to 25% later. The October PCE index rose, with core inflation the highest since 2023, firming expectations of a Fed rate hike in December.

title.bm: Tarif AS 'pengeluaran berlebihan' sasar 14 entiti ekonomi; inflasi teras Oktober tertinggi sejak 2023, jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed menguat
title.en: US tariffs on 'overproduction' target 14 economies; October core inflation highest since 2023, Fed hike bets firm up

why.bm: Kadar AS yang tinggi dan tarif lebih luas menekan ringgit, ekonomi Asia berorientasi eksport dan pengeksport Malaysia.
why.en: Higher-for-longer US rates and wider tariffs pressure the ringgit, export-driven Asian economies and Malaysian exporters.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan Beijing memberi amaran tindakan balas selepas langkah tarif baharu Washington, menimbulkan keraguan terhadap gencatan AS-China yang tamat Januari.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports Beijing has warned of retaliation after Washington's aggressive new tariff moves, raising doubts over the uneasy US-China truce that is due to expire in January.

title.bm: China ancam tindakan balas atas tarif baharu Trump, gencatan perdagangan dipersoal
title.en: China threatens retaliation over Trump's new tariffs, putting the trade truce in doubt

why.bm: Pertikaian perdagangan baharu memberi kesan kepada pengeksport dan rantaian bekalan Malaysia.
why.en: A renewed trade fight hits Malaysian exporters and supply chains.

summary.bm: S&P 500 jatuh sehingga 3.2% semasa dagangan sebelum mengurangkan kerugian (susut sekitar 0.3% pada 3:07 ptg ET), manakala Nasdaq susut 0.8% selepas jatuh 4.6% awal. Inflasi PCE Oktober naik kepada 3.8% daripada 3.6%; laporan menyebut Fed berkemungkinan menaikkan kadar pada Disember. Kospi jatuh 6.2% dan Nikkei 2.8%.
summary.en: The S&P 500 fell as much as 3.2% intraday before trimming losses (down about 0.3% at 3:07pm ET), while Nasdaq was down 0.8% after an early 4.6% drop. October PCE inflation rose to 3.8% from 3.6%, the article says the Fed is likely to hike in December; Kospi fell 6.2% and Nikkei 2.8%.

title.bm: Wall Street kurangkan kerugian rout AI; inflasi PCE AS 3.8%, kenaikan kadar Fed dijangka Disember
title.en: Wall St pares AI-rout losses; US PCE inflation hits 3.8% and Fed hike seen in December

why.bm: Kadar AS lebih tinggi dan kebimbangan saham AI boleh menekan ringgit, Bursa dan pengeksport teknologi Malaysia.
why.en: Higher US rates and AI-stock jitters can weigh on ringgit, Bursa and Malaysian tech exporters.

summary.bm: AP melaporkan Kospi jatuh 5.6% ke 4,725.84 (Samsung -9.1%), Nikkei 225 susut 3.6% (SoftBank -16.1%) dan TSMC merosot 8.1%, manakala Hang Seng naik 1%. Di Wall Street, S&P 500 turun 0.5% untuk kerugian kelapan dalam sembilan hari; Nvidia jatuh 5.9% dan Anthropic ditutup bawah harga IPO $83.
summary.en: AP reports Kospi fell 5.6% to 4,725.84 (Samsung -9.1%), Nikkei 225 lost 3.6% (SoftBank -16.1%) and TSMC dropped 8.1%, while Hang Seng rose 1%. On Wall Street the S&P 500 fell 0.5% for an eighth loss in nine days; Nvidia fell 5.9% and Anthropic closed below its $83 IPO price.

title.bm: Saham Asia jatuh akibat jualan AI: Kospi -5.6%, Nikkei -3.6%, Taiex susut lebih 6%
title.en: Asian stocks tumble on AI selloff: Kospi -5.6%, Nikkei -3.6%, Taiex down over 6%

why.bm: Turun naik saham cip dan AI boleh menjejas saham semikonduktor Malaysia, KLCI dan pelaburan berkaitan.
why.en: Semiconductor and AI-linked volatility may hit Malaysian chip stocks, KLCI and EPF-linked investments.

summary.bm: WSJ, Reuters dan FT melaporkan Washington sedang menyediakan tarif lebih tinggi, dengan rakan perjanjian mungkin dihadkan. Nasdaq jatuh 1.5% dan S&P 500 sekitar 0.5% pada Selasa, manakala Dow naik; keyakinan pengguna AS 103.3 berbanding jangkaan 92.5.
summary.en: WSJ, Reuters and FT reported Washington is preparing higher tariffs, with deal partners possibly capped. The Nasdaq fell 1.5% and the S&P 500 about 0.5% on Tuesday, while the Dow rose; US consumer confidence came in at 103.3 versus 92.5 expected.

title.bm: AS dilapor sedia naikkan tarif ke atas China, EU dan lain-lain; Wall Street susut selepas rali Nvidia
title.en: US reported preparing tariff increases on China, EU and others; Wall Street slips after Nvidia-led rally

why.bm: Tarif baharu boleh menjejaskan pengeksport Malaysia, ringgit dan pasaran serantau.
why.en: New tariffs could hit Malaysian exporters, ringgit and regional markets.

summary.bm: Sebuah lori tangki bahan api terbalik dan terbakar di jalan lingkar Warraq, Kaherah, petang Rabu, mengorbankan sekurang-kurangnya 31 orang dan mencederakan 21, menurut kementerian kesihatan Mesir.
summary.en: A fuel tanker overturned and burned on Cairo's Warraq ring road on Wednesday evening, killing at least 31 and injuring 21, according to Egypt's health ministry.

title.bm: Kebakaran lori tangki bahan api di Kaherah korbankan sekurang-kurangnya 31
title.en: Cairo fuel tanker fire kills at least 31

why.bm: Antara tragedi jalan raya paling maut minggu ini.
why.en: One of the deadliest road disasters of the week; a reminder of fuel-transport safety risks.

summary.bm: Gavi akan memulihkan pembiayaan bagi negara yang membeli vaksin malaria selepas memotong bajetnya awal tahun ini. Negara yang telah setahun melaksanakannya mencatat purata liputan 80% dos pertama dan 70% dos ketiga; malaria membunuh lebih 500,000 orang setahun, kebanyakannya kanak-kanak di Afrika sub-Sahara.
summary.en: Gavi will restore funding for countries buying the malaria vaccine after cutting its budget earlier this year. Countries with a year of rollout reached an average 80% first-dose and 70% third-dose coverage; malaria kills over 500,000 people a year, mostly young children in sub-Saharan Africa.

title.bm: Gavi pulih dana vaksin malaria dengan geran AS$214 juta
title.en: Gavi restores malaria vaccine funding with a US$214 million grant

why.bm: Berita baik untuk akses vaksin sedunia; pelancong ke kawasan malaria tetap perlu langkah pencegahan dan berjumpa doktor.
why.en: Good news for global vaccine access; travellers to malaria areas should still use prevention and consult a doctor.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan mahkamah mendapati kerajaan melanggar sebahagian perlembagaan dengan membenarkan kemudahan itu di pangkalan udara tentera di tengah Kenya; kerja lanjut dihentikan sehingga syarat dipenuhi. Projek itu mencetus protes maut.
summary.en: Reuters reports the court found the government breached parts of the constitution by allowing the facility at a military air base in central Kenya; further work is halted pending conditions. The project has sparked deadly protests.

title.bm: Mahkamah Kenya putuskan kemudahan kuarantin Ebola disokong AS melanggar perlembagaan
title.en: Kenyan court rules US-backed Ebola quarantine facility breached the constitution

why.bm: Menunjukkan sukarnya gerak balas wabak; wabak Ebola di DR Congo kini melepasi enam bulan.
why.en: Shows how hard outbreak response is to run; the DR Congo Ebola outbreak is now past six months.

summary.bm: CIDRAP melaporkan wabak masih merebak dengan kadar kematian kes sekitar 50%. WHO sebelum ini merekodkan lebih 11,000 kes Bundibugyo.
summary.en: CIDRAP reports the outbreak is still spreading with a case-fatality rate around 50%. WHO earlier counted over 11,000 Bundibugyo cases.

title.bm: Ebola di DR Congo genap enam bulan: penularan tidak terkawal dan keganasan baharu
title.en: Ebola in DR Congo at six months: rampant spread and new waves of violence

why.bm: Elakkan perjalanan tidak perlu ke kawasan terjejas dan ikut nasihat KKM.
why.en: Avoid non-essential travel to affected areas and follow KKM advisories.

summary.bm: Virginia melaporkan kematian campak pertama dalam hampir 50 tahun; kes AS menghampiri 6,000 (5,838 setakat 20 Nov).
summary.en: Virginia reports its first measles death in almost 50 years; US cases are near 6,000 (5,838 as of Nov 20).

title.bm: Kematian campak AS cecah 13 apabila Virginia dan Pennsylvania lapor kematian baharu
title.en: US measles deaths reach 13 as Virginia and Pennsylvania report new deaths

why.bm: Semak status vaksin MMR keluarga sebelum bermusafir.
why.en: Check your family's MMR vaccination before travel.

summary.bm: Menurut ringkasan pagi sebuah penyiar Korea, Trump turut mengugut menyerang semula kemudahan nuklear bawah tanah Iran, manakala Iran berikrar memecahkan sekatan maritim AS dan memberi amaran tindakan udara dan laut.
summary.en: Per a Korean broadcaster's morning digest, Trump also threatened to hit Iran's underground nuclear facility again, while Iran vowed to break the US maritime blockade and warned of air and sea action.

title.bm: Trump: boleh tamatkan perang Iran 'bila-bila masa' dan ugut serang semula tapak nuklear bawah tanah
title.en: Trump says he can end the Iran war 'whenever he wants' and threatens another strike on its underground nuclear site

why.bm: Risiko peningkatan ketegangan mengekalkan harga minyak sekitar $96 dan menaikkan kos bahan api serta perkapalan untuk Malaysia.
why.en: Escalation risk keeps oil near $96 and raises fuel and shipping costs for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan pasukan AS melumpuhkan sebuah kapal yang cuba meninggalkan Iran, manakala Tehran berikrar menentang sekatan laut AS. Ia menambah ketegangan di Hormuz yang telah mengekalkan harga minyak sekitar $96.
summary.en: Reuters reports US forces disabled a vessel trying to leave Iran, while Tehran vows to confront the US naval blockade. It adds to the Hormuz mine strikes and drone incidents that have kept oil near $96.

title.bm: AS lumpuhkan kapal yang cuba meninggalkan Iran ketika Tehran berikrar menentang sekatan
title.en: US disables ship trying to leave Iran as Tehran vows to confront the blockade

why.bm: Setiap pertembungan di laut meningkatkan risiko peningkatan ketegangan serta kos bahan api dan perkapalan untuk Malaysia.
why.en: Each clash at sea raises the risk of wider escalation and higher fuel and shipping costs for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Pihak berkuasa Kuwait berkata dua warga Itali maut akibat serpihan jatuh ketika cuba memintas dron Iran di sebuah tapak penting. Menlu Iran menyifatkannya 'resipi perang yang disediakan lebih awal', manakala Trump berkata Tehran diberi peluang berunding untuk mengelakkan lebih banyak korban.
summary.en: Kuwaiti authorities said two Italians died from falling debris while trying to intercept incoming Iranian drones at a vital site. Iran's FM called it a 'pre-cooked recipe for war', while Trump said Tehran has a chance to negotiate to prevent further loss of life.

title.bm: Kuwait: dua warga Itali maut dalam insiden dron Iran; Araghchi sebut 'mencurigakan'; Trump kata 'kemenangan di depan mata'
title.en: Kuwait says two Italians died in Iranian drone incident; Araghchi calls it 'suspicious'; Trump says 'victory at hand'

why.bm: Meluaskan konflik Teluk dan mengekalkan risiko kepada Hormuz dan harga minyak.
why.en: Widens the Gulf conflict and keeps Hormuz and oil prices at risk.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan Iran memberi amaran terhadap kehadiran tentera asing di Teluk ketika Seoul bersiap untuk peranan tentera laut yang lebih besar. Ia berlaku ketika Iran berkata akan menggunakan semua cara untuk menentang sekatan laut AS.
summary.en: Reuters reports Iran has warned against foreign military presence in the Gulf while Seoul prepares a larger naval role. It comes as Iran says it will use all tools to confront the US naval blockade.

title.bm: Iran beri amaran mengenai kehadiran tentera di Teluk ketika Korea Selatan bersedia memperluas peranan tentera lautnya
title.en: Iran warns on Gulf military presence as South Korea readies an expanded naval role

why.bm: Penglibatan tentera laut asing yang lebih luas meningkatkan risiko peningkatan ketegangan di Hormuz, laluan minyak utama Asia.
why.en: Wider foreign naval involvement raises the risk of escalation around Hormuz, a key route for Asia's oil.

summary.bm: Lithuania memberi amaran akan menarik balik status undang-undang pejabat perwakilan Taiwan melainkan namanya ditukar. Pemimpin EU sedang berunding bajet hampir EUR 1.6 trilion untuk 2028-2034 termasuk dana Ukraine, dan Trump berkata beliau meminta Putin berundur daripada tindakan ketenteraan di Eropah.
summary.en: Lithuania warned it will revoke the legal status of Taiwan's representative office unless it changes its name. EU leaders are negotiating a budget of nearly EUR 1.6 trillion for 2028-2034, including Ukraine funding, and Trump says he asked Putin to pull back military aggression in Europe.

title.bm: Lithuania ugut menarik status pejabat Taiwan di Vilnius; pemimpin EU berunding bajet 2028-34 dan dana Ukraine
title.en: Lithuania threatens Taiwan's Vilnius office status; EU leaders haggle over 2028-34 budget and Ukraine funding

why.bm: Ketegangan Taiwan-China dan pilihan perbelanjaan EU mempengaruhi kedudukan perdagangan dan keselamatan yang perlu ditangani Malaysia.
why.en: Taiwan-China tensions and EU spending choices shape trade and security alignments Malaysia must navigate.

summary.bm: Pertahanan udara Saudi menjatuhkan dua peluru berpandu balistik, satu peluru berpandu pelayaran dan satu dron berhampiran pelabuhan Jeddah sekitar tengah malam; tiada kecederaan orang awam dilaporkan. Utusan AS Jared Kushner berkata Trump mengekalkan semua pilihan terhadap Iran, manakala menteri luar Iran menuduh Israel cuba menarik AS ke perang baharu.
summary.en: Saudi air defences downed two ballistic missiles, a cruise missile and a drone near Jeddah port around midnight; no civilian injuries were reported. US envoy Jared Kushner said Trump keeps all options on Iran, while Iran's foreign minister accused Israel of trying to drag the US into another war.

title.bm: Arab Saudi memintas peluru berpandu dan dron Houthi ke arah Riyadh dan Jeddah; Trump 'kekalkan semua pilihan' terhadap Iran
title.en: Saudi forces intercept Houthi missiles and drones aimed at Riyadh and Jeddah; Trump 'keeps all options open' on Iran

why.bm: Serangan ke atas sasaran Saudi mengekalkan premium risiko minyak Teluk, menambah kos bahan api dan tambang.
why.en: Attacks on Saudi targets keep the Gulf oil risk premium high, feeding fuel and freight costs.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan media Iran berkata dua kapal tangki minyak terkena periuk api dan meletup di zon terhad pada Rabu (dakwaan Iran, belum disahkan bebas), mengancam pemulihan aliran Hormuz. Brent ditutup naik 3.5% pada Rabu dan didagangkan sekitar $94.7 awal Khamis; menteri OPEC+ bersidang mulai 29 Nov.
summary.en: Reuters reports Iranian state media said two oil tankers struck mines and exploded in a restricted zone on Wednesday (Iranian claims, not independently confirmed), threatening a recovery in Hormuz flows. Brent closed Wednesday 3.5% higher and traded near $94.7 early Thursday; OPEC+ ministers meet from 29 Nov.

title.bm: Hormuz: Iran dakwa sekurang-kurangnya dua kapal tangki terkena periuk api; Brent melonjak 3.5% kepada sekitar $94.6
title.en: Hormuz: Iran says at least two tankers hit mines; Brent jumps 3.5% to about $94.6

why.bm: Pelayaran melalui Hormuz hampir terhenti, risiko utama bagi kos bahan api dan pengangkutan di Malaysia.
why.en: Shipping through Hormuz stays near a standstill, a key risk for fuel and freight costs in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Cadangan Suruhanjaya Eropah memerlukan persetujuan kesemua 27 negara anggota, menambah lebih 70 kapal ke senarai armada bayangan, melarang firma EU menyediakan perkhidmatan kepada kilang penapis Rusia dan melanjutkan sekatan perkhidmatan tenaga kepada elektrik buat kali pertama. Ia dijangka dibincang pada Majlis Eropah 26–27 Nov; tiada tarikh mula diberikan.
summary.en: The Commission's proposal needs approval from all 27 member states and would add over 70 vessels to the shadow-fleet list, bar EU firms from servicing Russian refineries and extend energy-services curbs to electricity for the first time. It is expected to be discussed at the 26–27 Nov European Council; no start date is given.

title.bm: EU cadang pakej sekatan Rusia ke-22, termasuk larangan kapal tangki berinsurans Rusia
title.en: EU proposes 22nd Russia sanctions package, including ban on Russia-insured tankers

why.bm: Sekatan lebih ketat ke atas eksport minyak Rusia boleh menjejaskan harga tenaga dan insurans kapal tangki di seluruh dunia.
why.en: Tighter curbs on Russian oil exports could affect energy prices and tanker insurance worldwide.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan serangan Rusia merosakkan tapak tenaga dan gas Ukraine serta memutuskan bekalan elektrik di lima wilayah, manakala peluru berpandu balistik menghentam Kyiv dengan tujuh cedera, kata datuk bandar. Ukraine mendakwa menyerang sebuah pangkalan udara utama Rusia dan merosakkan lima pesawat; Zelenskiy memberi amaran serangan besar lain dalam beberapa hari.
summary.en: Reuters reports a Russian attack damaged Ukrainian energy and gas sites and cut power in five regions, and ballistic missiles hit Kyiv leaving seven wounded, the mayor said. Ukraine says it struck a major Russian air base damaging five planes, and Zelenskiy warned of another mass strike in coming days.

title.bm: Zelenskiy: Rusia bersiap serangan besar-besaran baharu selepas serangan putuskan bekalan elektrik lima wilayah dan hentam Kyiv
title.en: Zelenskiy says Russia is preparing a new mass strike after attacks cut power in five regions and hit Kyiv

why.bm: Serangan ke atas tenaga pada musim sejuk mengekalkan risiko keselamatan Eropah dan harga tenaga.
why.en: Winter attacks on energy keep Europe's security and energy-price risks elevated.

summary.bm: Seorang pekerja Nepal maut dan beberapa lagi cedera dalam serangan ke atas kilang minyak Jazan; media Saudi berkata kebakaran berlaku. Gabungan diketuai Saudi menyalahkan Houthi dan memberi amaran tindak balas ketenteraan tegas, manakala Iran menafikan terlibat dalam insiden dron Kuwait.
summary.en: A Nepali worker was killed and others injured in the attack on the Jazan refinery; Saudi media said a fire broke out. The Saudi-led coalition blamed the Houthis and warned of a firm military response, while Iran denied involvement in the Kuwait drone incident.

title.bm: Serangan dipersalahkan kepada Houthi ke atas kilang minyak Jazan Saudi bunuh seorang pekerja dan paksa penutupan separa
title.en: Houthi-blamed attack on Saudi Jazan refinery kills a worker and forces partial shutdown

why.bm: Menambah risiko bekalan tenaga Teluk yang mengekalkan Brent sekitar $95.
why.en: Adds to Gulf energy-supply risk that is keeping Brent near $95.

summary.bm: Surat berita melaporkan Anthropic menetapkan harga IPO $83 dan didagangkan sebagai ANT, dengan pemfailan menunjukkan perbelanjaan pengkomputeran sehingga $120.5 bilion dengan SpaceX hingga 2029. Ia juga memendekkan tempoh pendedahan kerentanan terkoordinasi daripada 90 kepada 30 hari mulai 1 Januari; angka berbeza sedikit antara surat berita. Ruangan Take Five Reuters pada 27 Nov menggambarkan IPO itu sebagai tidak menjadi.
summary.en: Newsletters report Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 and trades as ANT, and that its filing shows up to $120.5bn of compute spending with SpaceX through 2029. It will also shorten its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days from 1 January; figures differ slightly between newsletters. Reuters' Take Five column on 27 Nov described the IPO as a flop.

title.bm: Butiran IPO Anthropic: kira-kira $83 sesaham, tempoh pendedahan kerentanan 30 hari mulai Januari
title.en: Anthropic IPO details: about $83 a share, 30-day vulnerability disclosure window from January

why.bm: Tempoh pendedahan lebih pendek bermakna pasukan IT ada masa lebih singkat untuk menampal selepas kerentanan dilaporkan.
why.en: Shorter disclosure windows mean IT teams get less time to patch after a flaw is reported.

summary.bm: Satu ringkasan melaporkan pakej ini menambah Code Review (kini tersedia umum), PR Steward dan Claude Approvals, dicetus dengan /ship dalam Claude Code. Organisasi Enterprise layak boleh menuntut kredit $10,000 sebelum 15 Jan 2027; ini daripada ringkasan sekunder, bukan laman Anthropic.
summary.en: A digest reports the bundle adds Code Review (now generally available), PR Steward and Claude Approvals, triggered by /ship in Claude Code. Eligible Enterprise organisations can claim $10,000 in credits by 15 Jan 2027; this is from a secondary digest, not Anthropic's page.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar beta Claude Ship untuk pelan Team dan Enterprise
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Ship beta for Team and Enterprise

why.bm: Menunjukkan ejen pengekodan AI beralih ke aliran kelulusan dan keluaran; sahkan di laman Anthropic.
why.en: Shows AI coding agents moving into approvals and release workflows; verify on Anthropic's site.

summary.bm: 9to5Google melaporkan model baharu OpenAI dan Anthropic menimbulkan kebimbangan keselamatan dan kawalan, merujuk satu laporan. Butiran terhad dalam sumber yang dilihat.
summary.en: 9to5Google reports that new models from OpenAI and Anthropic are sounding alarms on safety and control, citing a report. Details are limited in the source seen.

title.bm: Laporan: model baharu OpenAI dan Anthropic menimbulkan kebimbangan keselamatan dan kawalan
title.en: Report: new OpenAI and Anthropic models raise safety and control concerns

why.bm: Penemuan keselamatan boleh mempengaruhi peraturan dan alat AI yang sanggup digunakan syarikat.
why.en: Safety findings can shape regulation and which AI tools firms are willing to adopt.

summary.bm: Levent Alpöge berkata hujah-hujah itu diformalkan tanpa andaian, dilaporkan dalam Lean. Bukti itu belum disahkan secara bebas. Pada 21 Nov komuniti Lean dan Mathlib menyatakan keyakinan penuh terhadap bukti Lean sekitar 17 juta baris itu, dan binaan semula bebas menghasilkan keputusan sama; Institut Clay masih menyenaraikan masalah itu sebagai terbuka.
summary.en: Levent Alpöge says arguments were formalised without assumptions, reportedly in Lean. The proof has not been independently verified. On 21 Nov the Lean and Mathlib communities said they had full confidence in the roughly 17-million-line Lean proof, and independent rebuilds reproduced it; the Clay Institute still lists the problem as open.

title.bm: Ahli matematik Anthropic dakwa beliau dan Claude menemui bukti hipotesis Riemann (belum disahkan)
title.en: Anthropic mathematician says he and Claude found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis (unverified)

why.bm: Anggap sebagai dakwaan belum disahkan sehingga disemak ahli matematik bebas.
why.en: Treat as an unverified claim until independent mathematicians check it.

summary.bm: Dompet ini dibina bersama American Express, Chase, Mastercard dan Visa. OpenAI turut memotong harga API GPT-6.2 Astra sebanyak 20% kepada $8 sejuta token input dan $40 sejuta token output.
summary.en: The wallet was built with American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa. OpenAI also cut GPT-6.2 Astra's API price 20% to $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

title.bm: OpenAI lancar ChatGPT Wallet supaya ejen AI boleh membayar tanpa melihat nombor kad
title.en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can pay without seeing card numbers

why.bm: Pembayaran oleh ejen AI semakin hampir, jadi jangkakan corak penipuan baharu juga.
why.en: Agent-led payments are arriving, so expect new scam and fraud patterns too.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Neon berharga AS$3 sejuta token input dan AS$15 sejuta token output, menurut rumusan berita AI.
summary.en: Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input and $15 per million output tokens, per AI news roundups.

title.bm: Google lancar Gemini 4 Neon dengan konteks 1 juta token
title.en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with 1M-token context

why.bm: Pilihan konteks panjang lebih murah untuk pembangun dan perniagaan.
why.en: Cheaper long-context option for developers and businesses.

summary.bm: Sebahagian perkhidmatan dihentikan; bayaran kebajikan dan pencen dilaporkan tidak terjejas. Secara berasingan, MI5 dan Kementerian Pertahanan UK memberi amaran kepada pembekal tentera UK untuk Ukraine tentang peningkatan sabotaj Rusia.
summary.en: Some services were taken offline; welfare and pension payments were reported unaffected. Separately, MI5 and the Ministry of Defence warned UK military suppliers to Ukraine about rising Russian sabotage.

title.bm: Jabatan Kerja dan Pencen UK lumpuhkan sebahagian perkhidmatan selepas 'insiden siber'
title.en: UK Department for Work and Pensions takes services offline after a 'cyber incident'

why.bm: Sasaran kerajaan dan rantaian bekalan menjadi tumpuan; semak kawalan akses dan berwaspada terhadap pancingan data yang menggunakan insiden ini.
why.en: Government and supply-chain targets are in focus; review access controls and watch for phishing that cites the incident.

summary.bm: Sinar Harian melaporkan AFP disasar serangan siber dan menggantung sementara platform kandungan AFP Forum. Tiada butiran pelaku diberikan.
summary.en: Sinar Harian reports AFP was targeted in a cyberattack and temporarily suspended its AFP Forum content platform. No details on attackers were given.

title.bm: Agensi berita AFP disasar serangan siber; platform AFP Forum digantung sementara
title.en: AFP news agency hit by cyberattack; AFP Forum platform suspended

why.bm: Pengguna media perlu jangka gangguan dan berhati-hati dengan e-mel mencurigakan atas nama AFP.
why.en: Media users should expect disruption and treat unusual AFP-branded emails with caution.

summary.bm: Penyerang menghubungkan kelemahan ini dengan PHP2Shell untuk mendapat akses root pada firewall yang terdedah ke internet; sebuah firma keselamatan melaporkan 24 firewall terjejas di satu organisasi. Palo Alto telah mengeluarkan hotfix.
summary.en: Attackers are chaining the flaw with PHP2Shell to take root on internet-exposed firewalls; one security firm reported 24 firewalls compromised at a single organisation. Palo Alto has a hotfix.

title.bm: Kelemahan PAN-OS Palo Alto 'Fragnesia' (CVE-2026-46300) dieksploitasi untuk akses root pada firewall terdedah
title.en: Palo Alto PAN-OS flaw 'Fragnesia' (CVE-2026-46300) exploited to gain root on exposed firewalls

why.bm: Kelemahan peranti rangkaian: pasang hotfix dan sekat akses internet ke antara muka pengurusan.
why.en: Network-device flaw: install the hotfix and block internet access to the management interface.

summary.bm: Nasihat VMSA-2026-0011 (24 Nov) merangkumi ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, Tools dan Avi Load Balancer. CVE-2026-123903 yang kritikal pada vmdir vCenter boleh dicapai melalui rangkaian tanpa keistimewaan; eksploitasi aktif belum disahkan.
summary.en: Advisory VMSA-2026-0011 (24 Nov) covers ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, Tools and Avi Load Balancer. The critical CVE-2026-123903 in vCenter's vmdir is network-reachable and needs no privileges; exploitation in the wild is not yet established.

title.bm: Broadcom tampal 23 kelemahan VMware termasuk pintasan pengesahan vCenter kritikal (CVSS 9.8)
title.en: Broadcom patches 23 VMware flaws incl. critical vCenter authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8)

why.bm: Semak Response Matrix dan tampal vCenter/ESX segera; hadkan pendedahan rangkaian pengurusan.
why.en: Check the Response Matrix and patch vCenter/ESX promptly; limit management-network exposure.

summary.bm: Penyerang tanpa pengesahan boleh menjalankan arahan sebagai root pada Expressway. Sebuah firma Rusia melihat peranti menghadap internet dibobol dan penyerang bergerak ke nod dalaman; CISA menyenaraikannya pada 23 Nov. Tampalan dikeluarkan 21 Okt.
summary.en: An unauthenticated attacker can run commands as root on Expressway. A Russian firm saw attackers breach internet-facing devices and move to internal cluster nodes; CISA listed it on 23 Nov. Fixes were released 21 Oct.

title.bm: Kelemahan kritikal Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8) dieksploitasi; CISA tambah ke KEV
title.en: Cisco Expressway critical flaw CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8) exploited; CISA adds to KEV

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: naik taraf ke versi dibaiki sekarang dan semak Expressway untuk tanda pencerobohan.
why.en: Network teams: upgrade to a fixed release now and check Expressway for signs of compromise.

summary.bm: 9to5Mac melaporkan Apple membuang Talkie milik MiniMax kerana kandungan seksual melibatkan kanak-kanak; aplikasi itu ada sekitar 11 juta pengguna bulanan pada Oktober.
summary.en: 9to5Mac reports Apple removed MiniMax's Talkie over sexual content involving minors; the app had about 11 million monthly users in October.

title.bm: Apple tarik chatbot AI China Talkie daripada App Store di seluruh dunia kerana kebimbangan keselamatan kanak-kanak
title.en: Apple pulls Chinese AI chatbot Talkie from the App Store worldwide over child-safety concerns

why.bm: Menunjukkan Apple menguatkuasakan peraturan keselamatan kanak-kanak App Store ke atas aplikasi teman AI.
why.en: Shows Apple enforcing App Store child-safety rules on AI companion apps.

summary.bm: Apple menjawab pemfailan Epic berhubung dokumen komisen App Store dalam pertikaian mahkamah yang berterusan.
summary.en: Apple responded to Epic's filing on App Store commission documents in the ongoing court dispute.

title.bm: Apple balas Epic atas dakwaan menyembunyikan 122,000 dokumen
title.en: Apple fires back at Epic over claims it withheld 122,000 documents

why.bm: Kes ini boleh membentuk yuran dan peraturan App Store untuk pembangun dan pengguna.
why.en: The case could shape App Store fees and rules for developers and users.

summary.bm: TechCrunch melaporkan kerajaan UK dipaksa mendedahkan perintah rahsia yang menuntut akses kepada data pengguna Apple.
summary.en: TechCrunch reports the UK government has been forced to disclose a secret order demanding access to Apple user data.

title.bm: Kerajaan UK dipaksa dedah perintah rahsia pintu belakang Apple
title.en: UK government forced to disclose secret Apple backdoor order

why.bm: Ia menyentuh keselamatan data iCloud disulitkan untuk pengguna di seluruh dunia.
why.en: It bears on the security of encrypted iCloud data for users worldwide.

summary.bm: Notifikasi ancaman Apple 29 Okt dihantar kepada pengguna di 99 negara; menteri Thailand berkata amaran sahaja tidak membuktikan peranti dijejaskan dan tiada bukti kaitan dengan Pegasus. SecurityWeek turut menerangkan bagaimana Secure Exclaves Apple melindungi data kamera dan mikrofon.
summary.en: Apple's 29 Oct threat notifications went to users in 99 countries; Thailand's minister said alerts alone do not show a device was compromised and no evidence links it to Pegasus. SecurityWeek separately explained how Apple's Secure Exclaves protect camera and microphone data.

title.bm: Apple bertemu pegawai Thailand berhubung amaran perisian intip selepas notifikasi ancaman 29 Okt
title.en: Apple meets Thai officials over spyware alerts sent after its 29 Oct threat notifications

why.bm: Jika menerima amaran ancaman Apple, kemas kini iOS dan pertimbangkan Mod Lockdown.
why.en: If you receive an Apple threat alert, update iOS and consider Lockdown Mode.

summary.bm: Choi Won-Joon mengambil alih bahagian mudah alih Samsung buat kali pertama dalam beberapa tahun.
summary.en: Choi Won-Joon takes charge of Samsung's mobile division for the first time in years.

title.bm: Bahagian mudah alih Samsung dapat ketua baharu selepas pelancaran Galaxy Z Fold 8
title.en: Samsung's mobile division gets a new head after Galaxy Z Fold 8 launch

why.bm: Perubahan kepimpinan boleh mempengaruhi harga dan hala tuju produk Galaxy.
why.en: Leadership changes can steer Galaxy pricing and product direction.

summary.bm: Laman utama Carian Google mendapat bar sisi sejarah sembang Gemini.
summary.en: The Google Search homepage is getting a Gemini chat-history sidebar.

title.bm: Laman utama Google lancar reka bentuk baharu berfokuskan AI dengan sembang Gemini anda
title.en: Google homepage rolls out AI-focused redesign with your Gemini chats

why.bm: Mengubah cara pengguna harian mencapai AI melalui Carian.
why.en: Changes how everyday users reach AI from Search.

summary.bm: Android Police berkata sesetengah pengguna Pixel 11 Pro dan Pro XL melihat skrin hitam atau ralat pada aplikasi kamera, berdasarkan hantaran pengguna dan bukan kerosakan meluas yang disahkan. Google belum mengeluarkan pembaikan rasmi; mematikan telefon 1–2 minit membantu sekurang-kurangnya seorang pengguna.
summary.en: Android Police says some Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL users see a black screen or error in the camera app, based on user posts rather than a confirmed widespread fault. Google has not issued an official fix; powering off for 1–2 minutes helped at least one user.

title.bm: Pemilik Pixel lapor pepijat kamera dan lain-lain selepas kemas kini Android 17 November
title.en: Pixel owners report camera and other bugs after the Android 17 November update

why.bm: Jika terjejas, mulakan semula dan tunggu pembaikan Google.
why.en: If affected, restart and watch for Google's fix before rolling back.

summary.bm: Menurut ringkasan penyiar Korea, Nvidia mengesahkan cip itu ditemui di pusat data yang dikaitkan dengan pihak di China; Jensen Huang, yang kembali mengurus syarikat, berdepan tekanan lagi jika penyeludupan terbukti.
summary.en: Per a Korean broadcaster's digest, Nvidia confirmed the chips were found at a data centre linked to a Chinese party; Jensen Huang, back in management, faces more pressure if smuggling is proven.

title.bm: Nvidia sahkan cip AI terkawal eksport dipasang di pusat data China
title.en: Nvidia confirms export-controlled AI chips were installed at a Chinese data centre

why.bm: Menambah desakan AS memperketat kawalan cip AI, yang sudah menjejaskan penghantaran Nvidia ke Malaysia.
why.en: Feeds the US push to tighten AI-chip curbs, which already hit Nvidia shipments to Malaysia.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan saham Nvidia melonjak 31% sehari selepas lembaga melantik semula Huang sebagai CEO, kemudian hilang hampir separuh dalam dua hari, dan S&P meletakkan syarikat itu pada pemantauan penurunan taraf. Huang dijadual hadir di jawatankuasa perbankan Senat pada 3 Disember.
summary.en: Reuters says Nvidia shares leapt 31% in one day after the board reinstated Huang as CEO, then gave back nearly half over two days, and S&P put the company on downgrade watch. Huang is due to testify before the Senate banking committee on 3 December.

title.bm: Lonjakan 31% Nvidia selepas Huang kembali separuh hilang; S&P letak pada pemantauan penurunan taraf
title.en: Nvidia's 31% jump after Huang's return is half given back; S&P puts it on downgrade watch

why.bm: Nvidia menjadi tunggak rantaian cip AI yang bergantung kepada sektor pusat data dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Nvidia anchors the AI chip chain that Malaysia's data-centre and semiconductor sectors rely on.

summary.bm: Bloomberg melaporkan SAP sedang menimbang pemotongan sekurang-kurangnya 10,000 pekerjaan ketika menstruktur semula perniagaan sekitar AI. Syarikat belum mengesahkan rancangan itu.
summary.en: Bloomberg reported SAP is weighing cutting at least 10,000 jobs as it restructures around AI. The company has not confirmed the plan.

title.bm: SAP dilapor pertimbang sekurang-kurangnya 10,000 pemotongan pekerjaan dalam penstrukturan semula AI
title.en: SAP reportedly considers at least 10,000 job cuts in AI restructuring

why.bm: Menandakan penstrukturan semula didorong AI dalam perisian perusahaan.
why.en: Signals AI-driven restructuring in enterprise software.

summary.bm: Financial Times melaporkan Nvidia meminta rakan seperti Dell dan Supermicro menghentikan penghantaran selepas peraturan baharu Jabatan Perdagangan AS (diumum 16 Nov) menutup lubang awan bagi syarikat China; penyedia awan diberi 90 hari untuk mendapatkan lesen. Bank turut menangguhkan pinjaman sekitar AS$480-500 juta bagi pusat data di Malaysia yang dikaitkan dengan ByteDance; Nvidia dan kerajaan Malaysia belum memberi reaksi dalam laporan yang dilihat.
summary.en: The Financial Times reported Nvidia told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipments after new US Commerce rules (announced 16 Nov) closed cloud loopholes for Chinese firms; cloud providers get 90 days to obtain licences. Banks also paused a loan of about US$480-500m for a Malaysia data centre tied to ByteDance; neither Nvidia nor Putrajaya has commented in the reports seen.

title.bm: Nvidia dilaporkan henti penghantaran pelayan AI ke Malaysia, Singapura, Thailand dan Indonesia
title.en: Nvidia reportedly halts AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia

why.bm: Malaysia meluluskan pelaburan pusat data dan awan RM123.5 bilion pada Jan-Sep 2026, jadi penghentian berpanjangan boleh menjejaskan projek Johor dan sektor ini.
why.en: Malaysia approved RM123.5bn of data-centre and cloud investment in Jan-Sep 2026, so a prolonged halt could hit Johor projects and the sector.

summary.bm: Menteri Hal Ehwal Agama, Dr Zulkifli Hasan, mendesak stesen itu membuang video tular tersebut serta-merta. Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Media Prima Audio menegur DJ terbabit dan berkata isu agama adalah sempadan yang tidak boleh dilanggar.
summary.en: Religious Affairs Minister Zulkifli Hasan urged the station to remove the viral video at once. Media Prima Audio's CEO reprimanded the DJs and said religion is off-limits.

title.bm: Menteri tuntut maaf stesen radio ekoran klip menyerupai solat
title.en: Minister demands apology from radio station over clip resembling Islamic prayer

why.bm: Kepekaan agama kekal garis merah dalam media Malaysia.
why.en: Religious sensitivities remain a red line in Malaysian media.

summary.bm: Pua mengesahkan hantaran Facebook itu miliknya selepas disoal siasat di Bukit Aman berkaitan minit Lembaga Pengampunan mengenai tahanan rumah Najib.
summary.en: Pua confirmed the Facebook post was his own after being questioned at Bukit Aman over the Pardons Board minutes on Najib's house arrest.

title.bm: Tony Pua beri keterangan 45 minit kepada polis berhubung hantaran pengampunan Najib
title.en: Tony Pua gives police a 45-minute statement over his Najib pardon post

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan kebebasan bersuara dan pengendalian dokumen yang dinyahrahsia.
why.en: Raises questions on free speech and handling of declassified documents.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan pemergiannya pada 27 Nov.
summary.en: Malay Mail reported his death on 27 Nov.

title.bm: Bekas Peguam Negara Abdul Gani Patail meninggal dunia pada usia 71
title.en: Former Attorney General Abdul Gani Patail dies at 71

why.bm: Tokoh penting dalam sejarah perundangan Malaysia.
why.en: A notable figure in Malaysia's legal history.

summary.bm: Menteri Besar Wan Rosdy memberi jaminan itu pada 27 Nov.
summary.en: Menteri Besar Wan Rosdy gave the assurance on 27 Nov.

title.bm: Pahang tidak abaikan kebajikan mangsa banjir berulang
title.en: Pahang says it will not neglect welfare of repeat flood victims

why.bm: Relevan ketika musim tengkujuh berterusan.
why.en: Relevant as the monsoon season continues.

summary.bm: Tuntutan dibangkitkan di Dewan Undangan Negeri pada 27 Nov.
summary.en: The demand was raised in the state assembly on 27 Nov.

title.bm: DUN Johor tuntut 25 peratus hasil cukai dikembalikan kepada negeri
title.en: Johor assembly demands 25% of tax revenue be returned to the state

why.bm: Berkait pembahagian hasil persekutuan-negeri.
why.en: Touches federal-state revenue sharing.

summary.bm: Majlis angkat sumpah diadakan di Istana Besar Seri Menanti, Kuala Pilah. Yang di-Pertuan Besar menitahkan exco baharu supaya kekal dalam bidang tugas masing-masing.
summary.en: The swearing-in was held at Istana Besar Seri Menanti, Kuala Pilah. The Yang di-Pertuan Besar told the new exco to stay within their portfolios.

title.bm: Enam exco baharu Negeri Sembilan mengangkat sumpah; Ismail Lasim kekal MB
title.en: Six new Negeri Sembilan exco sworn in; Ismail Lasim stays as MB

why.bm: Menamatkan ketidaktentuan politik negeri.
why.en: Ends the state's political uncertainty.
